data.description: First National Equities Limited is a limited liability company incorporated in Pakistan under the Companies Ordinance , 1984 (now the Companies Act, 2017) . The company is a holder pf TREC of Pakistan Stock Exchange. The principal activities of the Company include shares brokerage, consultancy services and portfolio investments.
